mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mdf_import_batch (import_kind, provider_code, file_name, file_hash, inserted_count, updated_count, skipped_count, rejected_count, status, error_report_json, dataset_version_id) VALUES (#{importKind}, #{providerCode}, #{fileName}, #{fileHash}, #{insertedCount}, #{updatedCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{rejectedCount}, #{status}, #{errorReportJson}, #{datasetVersionId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mdf_import_batch WHERE import_kind = #{importKind} AND file_hash = #{fileHash}
